title: 第5章 王山震惊他竟然这么强第6章 让你来找事这下老实了吧
slug: 亿倍返还双手插兜没有对手
lines: 滚滚巨力带着王山，一路撞穿一整排碗口粗的大树，烟尘四溅，最终将他狠狠钉在远处一块大石上。
那块大石足有五米多高，根部埋入地面不知多深，极为庞大沉重。
王山狠狠撞在上面，大石顿时被砸出一个人形裂缝，开始剧烈颤动，连带着根部都在颤动。
大石周围的地面也禁受不住这股力量，像水面波纹一样剧烈起伏。
“噗噗噗！
噗噗噗！”
王山只感到眼冒金星，头昏脑胀，随后从大石上摔下来，瘫坐在地上，大口大口的吐着鲜血。
他脸色一变再变，心头震惊。
苏长歌不是无法修行吗？
怎么会突然变得这么厉害？
这怎么可能！
联想到刚才的洗髓圣丹，他顿时明白了。
洗髓的丹药，不仅可以洗去身体内的杂质，其中蕴含的海量灵气更能让人在短时间内突破！
更何况，这还是天级洗髓之物！
药效和那些低级洗髓丹天差地别！
“他是怎么得到这种宝物的！
王山心里翻江搅海，羡慕无比。
他猛的想到了叶清瑶。
叶清瑶对苏长歌好是宗门人尽皆知的，让苏长歌抱着她的大腿吃软饭，这一吃就是整整四年。
原因是因为苏长歌长得帅气无比。
没办法。
女人大多都是看脸的，只有长得帅才能体会到女人有多主动。
说实话，王山以前是嫉妒的。
但现在他不敢嫉妒了。
苏长歌现在这么强，他不敢再找事了。
更何况他自己长得一言难尽，自知自己想吃软饭，也没那个命。
不过他也很疑惑，这种天级品质的丹药，叶清瑶又是从哪得来的？
苏长歌这时候走了过来，看着他冷笑道：“王山，你刚才不是说，像我这样的垃圾，你一个能打十个吗？现在怎么反而被我打飞了？”
王山只感到脸上火辣辣的，一句话也说不上来。
苏长歌体内迸发出更加深沉的力量，一股股气浪在周身炸响，雄厚的力量汇聚于拳头上，骨关节咔咔作响，爆发出恐怖无比的气势。
“你……你要干什么！”
王山脸色大变，有一种不好的预感！
“干什么？当然是杀你了！”
苏长歌提着拳头，寸寸逼近王山。
越是靠近他，气势就越恐怖一分。
王山只感到一股死亡的压迫寸寸逼近过来，越演越烈，吓得心脏扑通乱跳，一边后退一边大叫道：“不！
苏长歌，是我错了，我愿意道歉，我愿意道歉！
content_en:
"Boom——"
The rolling force carried Wang Shan, crashing through a row of big trees as thick as a bowl, sending smoke and dust everywhere, and finally nailed him to a large rock in the distance.
The boulder was more than five meters high, and its roots were buried deep into the ground. It was extremely large and heavy.
Wang Shan hit it hard, and a human-shaped crack was immediately created in the boulder. It began to tremble violently, including its roots.
The ground around the boulder could not withstand this force and undulated violently like ripples on the water.
“Puff puff puff!
Puff puff puff! "
Wang Shan felt like stars were shining in his eyes and his head was dizzy. Then he fell down from the boulder and collapsed on the ground, vomiting blood.
His expression changed again and again, and he was shocked.
Isn’t Su Changge unable to practice cultivation?
How could it suddenly become so powerful?
How is this possible!
Thinking of the Holy Marrow Cleansing Pill just now, he immediately understood.
The marrow-cleansing elixir can not only wash away impurities in the body, but the massive amount of spiritual energy contained in it can also help people achieve breakthroughs in a short time!
What's more, this is a heaven-level marrow cleansing thing!
The efficacy of the medicine is completely different from those low-grade marrow-cleansing pills!
"How did he get such a treasure!
? "
Wang Shan felt extremely envious.
He suddenly thought of Ye Qingyao.
Everyone in the sect knew that Ye Qingyao was fond of Su Changge, so he let Su Changge hold her thigh and eat soft rice for four whole years.
The reason is because Su Changge is extremely handsome.
no way.
Most women are judged by their looks. Only if you are handsome can you appreciate how proactive a woman is.
To be honest, Wang Shan was jealous before.
But now he didn't dare to be jealous.
Su Changge is so strong now that he doesn't dare to cause trouble anymore.
What's more, he himself is too handsome to describe, and he knows that he wants to live a soft life, but he doesn't have that fate.
But he was also puzzled, where did Ye Qingyao get such heaven-quality elixir?
Su Changge came over at this time, looked at him and sneered: "Wang Shan, didn't you just say that you could beat ten rubbish like me? Why are you being beaten away by me now?"
Wang Shan felt his face was burning and could not say a word.
"Boom!"
Deeper power burst out from Su Changge's body, and waves of air exploded all over his body. The strong power gathered in his fists, and his bones and joints crackled, erupting with a terrifying momentum.
"You...what are you going to do!"
Wang Shan's face changed drastically, and he had a bad feeling!
"What? Of course I'm going to kill you!"
Su Changge raised his fist and approached Wang Shan inch by inch.
The closer he got, the more terrifying his aura became.
Wang Shan only felt the pressure of death approaching, getting stronger and stronger. His heart was beating in fear, and he stepped back while shouting: "No!
Su Changge, I was wrong, I am willing to apologize, I am willing to apologize!
